set.body:
Outcome
Make one authored source govern browser/native palette, geometry and adapter values.

Owned scope
tokens; generator tooling; generated theme resources; generated typed metrics; design documentation

Prerequisites
A1

Acceptance criteria
- [x] Define raw/semantic/component roles for surfaces, meaningful text, decorative borders, essential control boundaries, action/focus/selection, invalid/disabled states, typography, density and motion.
- [x] Generate native CSS, initial dock-token outputs and typed logical metrics from one source; a second generation is byte-identical and CI detects edited or stale generated outputs.
- [x] Declare every foreground/background test pair and state. Normal meaningful text meets 4.5:1 and essential boundaries/focus information meet 3:1 where applicable; evaluate alpha compositing on actual backgrounds and record decorative/disabled exceptions explicitly.
- [x] Default meaningful text is at least 12 px, table content 13 px and general controls 14 px; comfortable/compact geometry starts at 32/28 control and 40/32 row minima without reducing text.
- [x] Scientific colormaps and data-series policy are explicitly outside UI palette generation; supplied illustrative curves are not validated scientific colormaps.

Required evidence
Determinism/staleness tests, pair-specific contrast report including composited values, token coverage/schema checks and generated-source provenance.

Completion rule
Record exact candidate/revisions, commands and exit status, retained evidence paths, and applicable limitations. No unrun checks or browser-only captures establish native correctness. Keep provider/app ownership in its own tracker. Implementers reserve exact paths before editing; shared source files have one writer. Use review until the stated reviewer/gate accepts.

Plan
PLAN.md — acceptance backlog code A2. Mote is authoritative for status and dependencies.

Local acceptance
2026-10-14: docs/evidence/a2/README.md, verification.json, source-manifest.json and retained exit-status logs. Source candidate 8b327c9a9f2c2cec3d3fe5756e762141576de659468458d935a13574d70ae65d (104 hashes); source-only, not Git-backed. 22 regressions, 224 required contrast pairs plus 12 explicit exceptions, 12 deterministic outputs, 130 actual JavaFX RGBA observations; all pass. CI stale-check workflow configured; hosted execution unrun. Full rendered theme, accessibility and dock behavior remain later gates.
